description: Returns the state of one Kubernetes cluster connected to Opservo: version, node conditions and capacity, workloads with ready counts and restarts, problem pods with their reason, last exit code and recent log lines, and recent warning events. Answers only for a cluster (kind kubernetes); a Linux server returns an error saying so.
name: get_kubernetes_snapshot

collected_at.description: When the snapshot was taken, ISO 8601.

error.description: Present only when the call failed: why, in plain English (unknown server, server from another workspace, not a Kubernetes cluster).

problems.description: Pods with a problem: reason, last exit code, restarts, recent log lines.

title: Kubernetes cluster snapshot
